# Kerdos

> Kerdos is a monthly service from SGD Ventures that looks after a local business's Google presence: Google Ads cost control, Google Maps profile, reviews, website care, one new Google page a month and work to help the business be found by AI assistants. Optional content package with ready-to-post social media posts.

Kerdos does not guarantee rankings or what any AI assistant says. It works on the things search engines and assistants rely on, and reports each month what changed.

## Plans
- Growth Plan: EUR 150 per month, cancel any time. First-month guarantee: refunded if the first report does not show both money saved and a measurable improvement.
- Growth + Content: EUR 250 per month. Everything in the Growth Plan plus 12 ready-to-post Facebook and Instagram posts, a monthly content plan and one website article a month.
